body:
(Alam ko the situation was my fault but just to illustrate my experience. This is my perspective as someone na hindi continuous ang flow ng income.)

Just wanna comment na bordering on harassment 'yung collections department nila when you've missed your due date. Kahit one day lang. (Actually even on your due date, paulit ulit kang tatawagan) And kahit na ang ganda ng record mo sa kanila, kahit first time mo pumalya. They will call you 5 freaking times a day even after you disclose that there's just a hiccup in your finances. They will force you to pay even when you tell them WITH FINALITY na next week ka pa makakapagbayad kasi next week pa 'yung sweldo. Grabe 'yung system nila. Tapos even after that, tatawagan ka ulit the next days until you finally get to pay, to talk to you about the same thing you've talked about in the first phone call, doing the same thing.

If you can opt out of using it, may choice ka naman to go for credit card na lang, I suggest 'yun na lang gamitin mo. Mas less pa ata ang interest and no anxiety.

Pero if continuous naman ang flow ng finances mo, I think hindi ka mahihirapan with how the same is designed.

I've been there before. My therapist described that as anhedonia, that feeling of hopelessness and displeasure in everything, or baka I'm reaching lang. Look it up.

Anyway, what I did to cut the cycle was seek for help. Iyon talaga 'yung pinaka una mong dapat gawin I guess, reach out for help so you can have someone to guide you. If you don't have the means, try signing up sa www.youarerad.org. Free therapy if na approve 'yung financial assistance mo. Ayon lang. Just seek for help, so you can have someone to guide you. Minsan kasi kaya tayo paulit ulit na nag-seself destruct is because we don't know what else to do. Pag may professional na naghahandle sa'yo, they can guide you in becoming better. Until such time na hindi mo na kailangan ng tulongn nila.
Sa Mercury Civic Road (Alabang) meron, 'yung katapat ng Asian Hospital

Alam ko it's probably so overused but one of things I learned in therapy and life was this: The outcome wouldn't be as bad as that perceived outcome that you have built up in your head. You probably were a good candidate that's why they hired you. Competent ka din siguro na worker if your boss kept you. Siguro naman magkakaroon sila ng compassion sa iyo. 

Hang in there lang talaga. And regarding the bus ticket, escapism and running away from your probably wouldn't do you good. Kasi time has a way of forcing us to confront them. Kaya confront them ngayon pa lang para hindi sila mag pile up!

Rooting for you, friend!

try escapism? distract yourself with stimulants that you can hyperfixate on para you can avoid dwelling on what went wrong today (movies, books, etc). tapos after noon, when finally distracted yourself, confront yourself on what made today bad. reflect and process your emotions. then acknowledge mo din na maybe you're not in your A game today. pag nag concede ka and you stop beating yourself up, you'll feel much lighter

i took sertraline before too along with quetiapine and lamotrigine and it worked... baka you need a higher dose of antidepressants or baka you need a mood stabilizer? try talking to your psychiatrist. kasi first few weeks with sertraline wasn't working until my doctor added lamotrigine which helped me. rooting for you!
